easyPrerequisites: ZImone's ability has triggered at least once this turn.
description:
Activate Jirina by sacrificing it.
When Jirina dies, Yedora triggers, returning Jirina from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
When Jirina enters the battlefield, Zimone triggers.
Holding priority, activate Jirina by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Zimone trigger, turning Jirina face-up.
Resolve the Jirina ability from step 1.
Repeat.
